$about.purpose: The both-directions canary for QA case A6. It is NOT a corpus fixture and is never read by test/fixtures/load.ts, which discovers only <service>/pages and <service>/errors.
$about.why: A4 and A5 cross-reference the normative PRD tables against SCALAR_ENV_KEYS. A cross-reference that has never been observed to fail is a cross-reference nobody has proven is wired up. Each case below is a deliberately-drifted miniature of the real inputs, run through the SAME parser and the SAME compare function the real assertion uses, so a change that neuters either one turns these red.
$about.note: The variable names here are invented and must never be registered anywhere in src/.

cases.name: a row in the table with no registration in the code
markdown: Prose the parser must skip over before it reaches the table.
